adds.title: Constitution of Georgia - 2017 reform, in effect 2018
adds.summary: Adopted 13 October 2017 and in effect from 2018 as amended 23 March 2018, Georgia's Constitution provides that all persons are equal before the law and prohibits discrimination on grounds of sex or any other grounds while requiring equal rights and opportunities for men and women, guarantees inviolability of human dignity with prohibition of torture and inhuman or degrading treatment, and guarantees to everyone free development of personality together with protection of life, physical integrity and liberty, with universally recognised human rights applying directly and international treaties prevailing over domestic acts unless conflicting with the Constitution.
